function: Predicts future downlink CSI (4 steps) from 16 noisy past CSI snapshots, TDD intra-band and FDD inter-band, in massive MIMO-OFDM (pp. 5, 8).
system: BS with dual-polarized 4x4 UPA (32 antennas), single-antenna UE; OFDM, 300 subcarriers per link at 30 kHz, 2.4 GHz; TDD and FDD; no RIS (p. 8).
method: Hybrid CNN residual, IDFT delay branch, adaptive correction layers, ShuffleNet and Transformer encoder, trained supervised with NMSE loss; separate TDD and FDD models (pp. 5-8, 10).
data_channel: Sionna-generated time-varying CSI: 3GPP TR 38.901 CDL-A/C/D, delay spreads 30-300 ns, speeds 1-30 m/s, 27,000 training samples, AWGN 0-25 dB; released as CSI-RRG (pp. 8-9).
test_conditions: Trained on CDL-A/C/D, 30/100/300 ns, 1/10/30 m/s, AWGN; tested on unseen CDL-B/E, 50/200/400 ns, 3-45 m/s, and phase, burst, packet-drop noise (pp. 9-10).
baselines: Learned: LLM4CP, STEMGNN, RNN, CNN; non-learned: no prediction (persistence), AR, PAD (Prony), Wiener; ablations of own modules (pp. 9-10, 18).
metrics: NMSE, spectral efficiency, scenario-wise rank, top-1 percentage, FLOPs, parameters, inference time, memory (pp. 10-12, 16).
complexity: Table 8: TDD 21.9 M parameters, 71.9 G FLOPs, 8.1 ms inference; FDD 38.6 M, 101.6 G, 18.7 ms (p. 21).
q1_support: p. 8: "TR 38.901 [64] CDL-A, CDL-C, and CDL-D models" - training data generated with Sionna; CDL-B/E added for testing (p. 9).
q2_support: p. 9: "included during training while CDL-B/E are reserved" - also unseen delay spreads (50, 200, 400 ns) and velocities up to 45 m/s in the Generalization track.
q3_support: p. 9: "LLM4CP [35]: Together with CSI-BERT2 [36]," - learned baselines LLM4CP, STEMGNN, RNN, CNN; p. 10: "Wiener [68]: A classical Wiener filter baseline that" - non-learned NP, AR, PAD, Wiener; all compared on NMSE and spectral efficiency.
q4_support: p. 16: "comparable to CNN and only about 1/5 of LLM4CP; its" - FLOPs; parameters, inference time and memory in Table 8, p. 21.
notes: Area 2: CSI prediction in TDD (intra-band) and FDD (inter-band); the paper proposes CSI-4CAST and also releases the CSI-RRG benchmark. All data are simulated with Sionna from 3GPP TR 38.901 CDL models; the paper itself notes there are no measured data (p. 20). The paper reports that no model generalizes reliably to unseen FDD scenarios (pp. 13-14).
